units.source_text: 薰中纳言答道：“这一件事，依愚见看来，是不能效劳的。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, replied, "In my humble opinion, I cannot be of service in this matter.

units.source_text: 总须将尊意直率告知亲王，遵照他的指示行事，方为妥善。

en.t: It would be best to tell the prince frankly of your wishes and then act according to his instructions.

units.source_text: 不然，万一稍有差错，亲王必将怪怨小姐轻率，结果实甚不佳。

en.t: Otherwise, if the slightest thing goes wrong, the prince will surely blame you, my lady, for acting rashly, and the outcome will be very unfortunate.

units.source_text: 只要不被亲王误解，则往来迎送之事，小生自应一力担当，岂敢惮劳！

en.t: So long as the prince does not misunderstand, I will naturally take full responsibility for escorting you back and forth; how could I shrink from the trouble?

units.source_text: 小生为人一向正直无私，迥非寻常男子可比，此乃亲王所深悉也。”

en.t: I have always been upright and free of selfish motives, quite unlike ordinary men, and the prince knows this very well."

units.source_text: 他口上虽如此说，其实深悔从前将二女公子让与匂亲王，无时或忘。

en.t: Though he spoke this way, in truth he deeply regretted having once yielded the Second Princess to Prince Niou, and he never forgot it.

units.source_text: 只想如古歌所咏“但愿流光能倒退”，而把二女公子娶了回来。

en.t: He wished only that, as an old poem says, time might flow backward, so that he could take the Second Princess back as his wife.

units.source_text: 此时他对二女公子隐约吐露此意。

en.t: At this moment he hinted at these feelings to the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 谈谈说说，不觉天色渐暗。

en.t: As they went on talking, the sky gradually darkened before they knew it.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得不便久留他在帘内，便对他说：“罢了，今天我心绪恶劣，且待稍见好转，再行请教。”

en.t: The Second Princess felt it was improper to keep him too long inside the curtain, so she said to him, "That will do for now. I am in poor spirits today; when I feel a little better, I will ask your advice again."
Having said this, she was about to withdraw into the inner room.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言十分懊丧，连忙说道：“那么，小姐准备几时动身呢？

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was deeply disappointed and quickly said, "Then when do you intend to set out, my lady?

units.source_text: 我可吩咐他们将路上蔓草稍稍清除。”

en.t: I can have them clear away some of the creeping grass along the road."
He was trying to please her.

units.source_text: 二女公子暂时止步，答道：“本月已将过完，下月初动身吧。

en.t: The Second Princess stopped for a moment and answered, "This month is nearly over, so I will leave at the beginning of next month.

units.source_text: 只要悄悄地前往就好了，不必郑重其事地求人准许。”

en.t: It will be enough to go quietly; there is no need to make a formal matter of asking anyone's permission."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言觉得这声音非常可爱，便比平时更热烈地回想起往事来。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, found her voice exceedingly lovely, and he recalled the past even more passionately than usual.
